Vikas M Email: vm084830@gmail.com | Mobile: +91 9341735150 Location: Bengaluru, India

Finance Professional Finance Professional with close to 8 years of progressive experience in Fund Accounting, NAV Calculation, Trade Processing, and Investment Operations across Hedge Funds, Mutual Funds, and Pension Funds. Experienced in end-to-end fund accounting, trade lifecycle support including trade validation, pricing, corporate actions, reconciliations, and NAV finalization within global investment banking environments.

Professional work experience

Goldman sachs: Under the payroll of (ENIL India pvt ltd)

Role: Senior Associate - May 2023 – Nov 2025

Prepare / validate the NAVs of the hedge fund accounting clients on a daily/Monthly basis. • Booking of Capital Activities of the fund. • Prepare Cash/Position/Market Value Reconciliations and resolving breaks. Notify Clients/CSMs of validbreaks. If break is due to an erroneous or missing transaction in accounting system, then make necessary adjustments

Resolving all queries raised by clients on NAV and daily reporting of Estimates. • Checking that all OTC products traded by the client have been booked correctly. • Reviewing pricing of the portfolio and analyzing the pricing exceptions if any. • Reviewing the corporate actions booked in the system and ensuring that the same is correctly reflected in the books. Dividends/Interest Reconciliation with Broker reports

Finalizing the month end NAV of the client and providing Investor Level Allocation reports at month -end. • Supporting in Audits for funds in the preparationon financial statements. Completeaudit reviews and ensure identified issues are documented and tracked to closure.

HSBC, Bengaluru:

Role: Sr. Analyst Fund Accounting - Nov 2021 – NOV 2022

Making deliverables/task allocation among team members including Daily, And Non -Daily activities

Ensures sufficient cross training is provided for the team members and identifies their training & development needs.



Identification of Process Improvement ideas and working on its implementation in the present process.

Reviewing and updating the SOPs for the entire Daily & Non-daily task.

Make sure sign-off is received from Cash, Position, Pricing and CA team before we start Pre-NAV activities.

Calculating and Booking of Admin Fees, Management Fees, & Performance fees in a fund.

Ensure appropriate accounting methods are followed for accrual & payment of Performance and Management fees.

JP Morgan Chase & Co., Bengaluru: March 2018 – Dec 2020

Role: Fund accounting, Operation Analyst

Ensuring all the tasks & deliverables are completed within the agreed SLA.

Make sure sign-off is received from Trade, Expense, TA & COAC team before triggering EMS rule on Invest One.

Final review of control functions like EMS, Pricing checks & complete GAV/NAV process checks

Making deliverables/task allocation among team members including Daily, weekly, Monthly & Quarterly activities.

Ensure appropriate accounting method is followed for accrual & payment of Performance and Management fees.

Handling and resolving queries from various team members, Clients, Auditors and others JPM colleagues.

Wipro BPS Ltd Payroll Bengaluru: Oct 2016 – Dec 2017 Role: Fund Accounting, Analyst

Validating tolerancebreach foreveryactivitybookedinto fund formaterial/immaterial breach irrespective if it is Cash, Trade, Income, Expense, TA, derivative or Corporate Action related.



Involved in complete NAV-GAV process.

Checking price of securities in a fund with BBG/IDS/Thompson Reuters and pricing a security as per client instruction.

Reconciliation/Booking of Inflationary bonds, Pay downs, currency sweeps, different types of options.

Perform Income streaming for OTC products like Options, Swaps, and Futures as per UK regulatory requirement.

Performing Asset, Cash, Market value and Accrued Income reconciliation for all the securities in portfolio.

Working on periodic testing of the tools/applications related to Fund Accounting i.e Invest one, Fusion, Fission etc.

Handling & Closing EMS on daily basis related to Trades, TA, Cash, Income, Expense, Pricing & Corporate Action.

Education:

2014-2016:-

MASTER’S IN BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION (FINANCE) Bangalore University.

2011-2014:-

BACHELOR OF BUSINESS MANAGEMNT (Finance) SJRC college, Bangalore University.

2010-2011:-

PRE-UNIVERSITY COURSE (PUC) Rural PU college, Karnataka PU board

Declaration

Taking above-mentioned facts, which are correct to the best of my knowledge. If I am given a chance to perform in your esteemed organization, I assure to my best service always and at all levels.

Date:

(Vikas M)
